question:
What fraction of the square is shaded?

[Figure 1](figures/1990_AMC_8_Q03_question_fig1.svg)
solution:
The drawn diagonal suggests folding the square to compare its pieces without calculating their individual areas.

[Figure 1](figures/1990_AMC_8_Q03_question_fig1.svg)

Reflect across the diagonal from the bottom-left corner to the top-right corner. The small shaded triangle matches the small unshaded triangle. The middle shaded piece matches the middle unshaded piece, and the top shaded piece matches the unshaded piece on the right.

Reflection preserves area, so each pair contains equal shaded and unshaded areas. Since the three pairs fill the square, half of the square is shaded. The fraction is \(\boxed{\tfrac12}\), choice \(\text{E}\).
